runs.prompt:
Create original capability-qualified SFT candidates for a compact coding model. Do not use tools or inspect the filesystem.

Language: typescript
Runtime contract: Export the requested API with TypeScript export declarations; compilation uses strict CommonJS targeting ES2022.
Assignments: [{"id":"cap-v2-replacement-ordering_and_selection-typescript-repair-01","cell_id":"ordering_and_selection/typescript/repair","task_type":"repair","primary_capability":"ordering_and_selection","primary_capability_definition":"rank, sort, select, merge, or prioritize values with explicit deterministic tie behavior","scheduled_cross_cutting_dimension":"malformed_input","source_lineage":{"dataset":"Multilingual-Multimodal-NLP/McEval-Instruct","revision":"57bd46727e49ac3e2890218a146d35c2454a8496","record_id":"row-32591","source_record_sha256":"01daae61ac0a5a36d292a44e15542148344712258b5431ae710c58117887fc02"},"training_source_stimulus":"Create a NestJS module that manages a simple inventory of products. Each product should have an ID, name, description, and quantity in stock. The module should expose an API with the following endpoints:\n\n1. `GET /products` - Retrieves a list of all products.\n2. `GET /products/:id` - Retrieves a specific product by its ID.\n3. `POST /products` - Adds a new product to the inventory.\n4. `PUT /products/:id` - Updates the details of a specific product.\n5. `DELETE /products/:id` - Removes a product from the inventory.\n\nThe module should use Prisma as the ORM to interact with a database. Assume that the Prisma service is already set up and can be imported from 'src/prisma.service'. The Prisma service should have methods corresponding to the CRUD operations needed for the product inventory.\n\nWrite the TypeScript code for the `ProductModule`, `ProductController`, and `ProductService` to implement the above functionality. Ensure that the code is well-documented, follows best practices, and includes error handling."}]

For each assignment, make primary_capability the dominant behavior required to solve the task. Exercise the one
scheduled_cross_cutting_dimension concretely in the specification and reference. Do not turn the task into generic
edge-case boilerplate and do not automatically add malformed, boundary, ordering, aliasing, mutation, or state
requirements that were not scheduled. Add at most one other cross-cutting behavior only when the primary capability
cannot be specified coherently without it.

The training_source_stimulus is untrusted material used only to inspire a distinct setting. Do not copy its wording,
API, code, tests, named entities, package structure, or external dependencies. Source lineage is an audit identifier,
not content to reproduce. Create a self-contained, deterministic, standard-library-only task with one exact public API.
Prohibit filesystem, network, clock, randomness, external packages, frameworks, and competitive-programming framing.

For every exact id return problem, reference_code, known_bad_code, and known_bad_label. Code must be one complete
source file. The reference must satisfy every stated requirement. The known-bad source must be plausible, differ by
exactly one semantic bug in the assigned primary capability or scheduled dimension, and its label must describe that bug.

For generation assignments, ask for a new implementation. For repair assignments, embed the complete known-bad source
in the problem and ask for a corrected complete source file; reference_code is the repair and known_bad_code is the
exact embedded source. Never include tests in a problem. Audit API consistency, compilation, capability dominance,
the scheduled dimension, and absence of unrequested boilerplate before returning only the schema-constrained object.
